item.title: TT-102: RFC 4180 CSV export
item.brief:
Implement only TT-102 from BACKLOG.md in the long-backlog repository.

Acceptance criteria:
- tasktracker.export.to_csv(tasks) produces RFC 4180 CSV.
- Header is id,title,tags,status,due; one row per task in input order.
- Tags are joined with ';'; due date is ISO YYYY-MM-DD or empty.
- Fields containing comma, double quote, CR, or LF are wrapped in double quotes, with embedded double quotes doubled. Fields without those characters are not quoted.
- Every line, including header, ends with CRLF.
- Add tests for the behavior.
- Use only Python's standard library. Run exactly: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
- Commit this ticket separately in one commit; do not include changes for other tickets.

Operator request: implement all four tickets following their acceptance criteria, keep existing tests passing, add tests, use only the standard library, and commit each ticket separately.

item.title: TT-103: Search query syntax
item.brief:
Implement only TT-103 from BACKLOG.md in the long-backlog repository.

Acceptance criteria:
- tasktracker.search.search(tasks, query) supports terms split on whitespace except inside double quotes; "fix login" is one phrase term. All terms must match (AND).
- Bare words and phrases match titles case-insensitively.
- tag:NAME matches an exact tag case-insensitively.
- status:open and status:done match status.
- Any other field:value term, an unknown status, or an unterminated quote raises tasktracker.search.QueryError.
- Empty or blank query matches every task; result order is the input order.
- Add tests for the behavior.
- Use only Python's standard library. Run exactly: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
- Commit this ticket separately in one commit; do not include changes for other tickets.

Operator request: implement all four tickets following their acceptance criteria, keep existing tests passing, add tests, use only the standard library, and commit each ticket separately.

item.title: TT-104: Undo
item.brief:
Implement only TT-104 from BACKLOG.md in the long-backlog repository.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add TaskStore.undo() to revert the most recent not-yet-undone add, complete, or delete, walking backward in LIFO order across all three operation kinds.
- Undoing add removes that task; undoing complete reopens it; undoing delete restores it exactly as it was under the same id.
- Ids are never reused, including after undoing an add.
- With no undoable operation, raise tasktracker.store.NothingToUndo.
- Failed operations (for example completing an unknown id) are not recorded.
- Add tests for the behavior.
- Use only Python's standard library. Run exactly: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
- Commit this ticket separately in one commit; do not include changes for other tickets.

item.title: TT-101: Reject impossible due dates
item.brief:
Implement only TT-101 from BACKLOG.md in the long-backlog repository.

Acceptance criteria:
- tasktracker.dates.InvalidDate is a ValueError subclass.
- Impossible calendar dates (2026-02-30, 2025-02-29, 2026-04-31, 2026-13-01, 2026-00-10) raise InvalidDate whose message contains the original input text.
- Any unsupported form also raises InvalidDate, not bare ValueError.
- Relative offsets +Nd mean N days after today; +0d means today. Negative and unsigned offsets such as -3d and 3d raise InvalidDate.
- today and tomorrow continue working; matching is case-insensitive and ignores surrounding whitespace.
- Add tests for the behavior.
- Use only Python's standard library. Run exactly: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
- Commit this ticket separately in one commit; do not include changes for other tickets.

Operator request: implement all four tickets following their acceptance criteria, keep existing tests passing, add tests, use only the standard library, and commit each ticket separately.
